subject: Indemnity handover: defense lead assignment & evidence staging
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marino <elena.marino@acmeinc.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Indemnity handover: defense lead assignment & evidence staging

Hi Elena / Acme team —

Thanks for the quick review on the MSA + order form. We attached our initial redlines (redwood-redlines_v1.docx) with two items we want to confirm before the next legal pass:

1) Defense lead assignment for third-party IP claims: Redwood proposes that for third-party infringement claims alleging customer use of customer-provided data or prompts, Redwood will accept defense control up to a $250,000 threshold (defend-and-pay scenario). Above $250k, the parties will coordinate a joint-defense lead escalation process.

2) Escrow / evidence staging: rather than a full escrow activation on first notice, we propose an evidence-staging bucket (S3-like) where Redwood will provide a packaged evidence export within 48 hours of a validated notice. Escrow only triggers on litigation/insurance invocation. The evidence-staging checklist is included as a stub in the attachment.

We want to avoid protracted back-and-forth on who 'controls' counsel for smaller claims but also preserve Acme's right to step in on material claims. If this approach works for you, we'll bake the wording into the MSA redline and share v2.

Suggested next step: 30-minute sync Thursday to walk through concrete language and the evidence handoff workflow.

Thanks —
Karthik
SVP, Legal & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-redlines_v1.docx (MSA + order form redline), evidence-staging-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Elena Marino <elena.marino@acmeinc.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>, legal.ops@acmeinc.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Indemnity handover: defense lead assignment & evidence staging

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear proposal. A few high-level comments from Acme legal:

- Threshold mechanics: $250k as a defend-and-pay cutoff is reasonable in principle, but we need explicit language about allocation of defense costs during the joint-defense phase (who pays in the interim, whether fees are escrowed).
- Evidence staging: 48 hours to provide a packaged export is aggressive but workable if you confirm the export includes native prompts + model/seed metadata + hashes and a signed chain-of-custody statement from Redwood.
- Control / reservation of rights: Acme needs an explicit reservation that accepting Redwood's defense up to the threshold does not waive Acme's right to seek indemnity remedies later.

Procurement is also asking for a short mutual action plan so we can align internal approvals (legal -> procurement -> IT ops) if we accept this approach. Do you have a template MAP you can share?

We can do Thu 10am PT for a call — Elena + one counsel, Procurement may hop on.

Thanks,
Elena Marino
Senior Counsel, Acme Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marino <elena.marino@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Indemnity handover: defense lead assignment & evidence staging

Thanks Elena —

We heard the feedback and I attached a refreshed redline (redwood-redlines_v2.docx) that: 
- Adds interim-cost allocation language for the joint-defense window (Redwood pays initial defense costs up to $50k, thereafter the parties split 50/50 unless insurance applies).
- Expands the evidence export spec to include model version, input timestamps, and verification hashes + a short chain-of-custody affidavit template.
- Adds explicit reservation-of-rights language in the indemnity paragraph.

Couple of operational notes for the call:
- Evidence export scope: we'll provide one packaged export per notice. If multiple notices arise from the same underlying allegation, we'll collate into a single package and flag duplicates.
- We propose a named "Evidence Liaison" on both sides (Redwood: Ops Lead; Acme: Legal Ops) who will own the 48-hour SLA and validate the package.

I can share a short MAP template during the call (one-pager). Confirming Thu 10am PT works for Karthik + Elena.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Legal Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-redlines_v2.docx (updated language), evidence-staging-checklist.xlsx (updated)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Marino <elena.marino@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Indemnity handover: defense lead assignment & evidence staging

+1 to Marissa's approach. Practical compromise suggestion for the call:
- Keep defend-up-to $250k language but add an "insurance-first" clause: if the claim is covered by either party's insurance, insurance carriers will coordinate payment and defense lead (we will require a short notice to counsel contact).
- Operationalize the liaison role with a short-runbook: 1) acknowledgement within 4 hours; 2) evidence package within 48 hours; 3) weekly sync until matter closed.

I can draft the runbook during the call and add it as an appendix.

Ben
Director, Sales Legal (Deals)
Redwood Inference

Team —

Appreciate the constructive back-and-forth. Quick recap and agreed next steps from Redwood's side based on today's exchange: 

1) Wording: Redwood will update the MSA redline to reflect: defend-and-pay up to $250k; interim cost allocation (Redwood covers first $50k, 50/50 split thereafter during joint-defense); explicit reservation of rights for Acme.

2) Evidence: Redwood will deliver a packaged evidence export including prompts, timestamps, model version and verification hashes + chain-of-custody affidavit. SLA: packaged export within 48 hours of validated notice. We will produce a short evidence-runbook appendix for the MSA.

3) Liaison + MAP: Redwood will nominate an Evidence Liaison (Ops) before execution; Marissa to share the one-page mutual action plan template during the call. Procurement: please confirm internal approval path so we can align dates.

Action owners / timeline: 
- Marissa: update redline + runbook appendix (deliverable: redwood-redlines_v3.docx) — due EOD Mon 6/7.
- Ben: draft runbook appendix & MAP bullet points — deliverable: runbook-draft.md — due Tue 6/8.
- Elena / Acme: confirm internal approval path & whether counsel will accept the reservation-of-rights language — reply by Tue 6/8 if possible.

I'll put the call on the calendar for Thu 10am PT and include the HubSpot deal and DocuSign links in the invite.

Best,
Karthik
SVP, Legal & Ops
Redwood Inference
